messages.author: 8f92b1b8d64c1a7d
messages.subject: Conditional nrows in facetting
parts:
Good morning,

When specifying the number of rows in facet_wrap, is there a way to set it conditionally, based on the number of plots? I'm making multi-page PDFs with one page per group of multiple graphs, and each group has a different number of associated graphs on the page. I'd want to specify, if there are x number of graphs, use y rows, a number of graphs, use z rows, etc.

Thanks!

Stefanie Trop

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: Conditional nrows in facetting
parts:
Number of graphs in your case is probably the number of levels. If that's true, you could adapt the number of rows dynamically.

Something along the lines of 

nr <- ifelse(length(levels(x))  == 6, 3, else 2) # something smart here
ggplot(...) + facet_warp(..., nrow = nr)

Cheers,
Roman
